selection: Shuffle the archived, lexically ordered representatives with random.Random(seed), independently of outputs; take a nested prefix of min(k, available). Reuse exactly the same indices for all scoring rules.
corpora: all distinct adjacent swaps of each task's designated reference
control_policy: Select the designated reference before reading outcomes. Enumerate every adjacent swap, omit the unchanged sequence and deduplicate per task. Replay supplies labels; no DAG-based filtering. Score controls against their single source reference.
bootstrap_unit: task; keep all model outputs and average reference-selection seeds within each task
purpose: Separate the effect of adding references from the effect of relaxing their total orders. This is not a model-selection or physical-success experiment.
status: Analysis design fixed before computing the new matched-reference results; existing outcomes and prior sensitivity findings are already known. Not a prospective preregistration.
